description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering leave entitlement search results within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a date range filter and includes properties for employee numbers, leave type ID, and deletion status, along with their getter and setter methods.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO used for specifying search filter parameters for leave entitlement queries, including employee info, leave type, and sorting options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter with a default sort field.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter value.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter value.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns an array of employee numbers for filtering.

methods.name: setEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the array of employee numbers for filtering.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Returns the leave type ID filter value.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Sets the leave type ID filter value.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeDeleted
methods.description: Returns the boolean indicating if the leave type is deleted.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeDeleted
methods.description: Sets the boolean indicating if the leave type is deleted.
